findings.label: Dead "selected" preview in modal
findings.detail: mediapick__selected is set then the modal closes synchronously in the same handler, so it never paints. Selected details are still shown via the tile grid before selection and the caller's own preview after, so the requirement is met elsewhere. No action required.

findings.label: S3 newest-first is page-local
findings.detail: S3StorageProvider.list sorts only the first ListObjectsV2 page (<=1000 objects, no continuation token), so with a very large bucket the newest item might not surface. Acceptable for a read-only library capped at 500; worth a comment if the bucket is expected to exceed 1000 images.
